name: Elder Fashioned
description: A gin Old Fashioned sweetened with St-Germain instead of sugar, with orange bitters and a grapefruit twist.
history: Phil Ward’s drink from Death & Co in New York, one of the first bartender classics built on St-Germain after its 2007 launch.
whyItWorks: Elderflower is both sweetener and botanical, so it slots into the Old Fashioned template without fighting the gin. Grapefruit oil sharpens the floral edge.
steps: Stir gin, St-Germain and orange bitters with ice until cold.
Strain over a large cube in a rocks glass.
Express a grapefruit twist over the top and drop it in.
techniqueNotes: The original used Plymouth. Of what is here, Hendrick’s leans into the floral side; Drumshanbo is greener and sharper.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Rose and cucumber meet the elderflower halfway.

creator: Phil Ward
